# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- User prefers validation logic kept inside the AngularJS controller as explicit if statements matching the existing inputValidation style, without using trim or HTML min/max-length constraints unless explicitly requested.

## C# Class Guidelines
- For C# map classes in this project, order using directives exactly as requested: ITEWebApplicationProject.Models.Tables first, followed by System, System.Collections.Generic, System.Data.Entity.ModelConfiguration, System.Linq, and System.Web. Include these directives before the Entity Framework and model namespace imports.
